snippet.title: Drag Race - (1977) - Arcade - gameplay HD
snippet.description:
Drag Race © 1977 Kee Games.
[Coin-Op] Arcade Video Game

A basic drag racing game - but among the better versions in this time frame (the home consoles were not so good).  Quickly shift the gears at just the right time for a fastest time... plus the added challenge of keeping your car straight on the road.  Not sure how - but I scored 5.5 sec.
